summary: Adopt the v2 relief law (h proportional to g^-1.09, Guimond+2022) above g=1 with the calibrated g^-0.58 fit retained below as a labelled data boundary; move RELIEF_FLOOR off 0.40; connect the two radius-blind gravity feeds (uPerturb and the flat bodyDrivers.massGravity D14 slot) so the adopted physics reaches the screen. Ordering is load-bearing and is an acceptance criterion.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Relief follows the ruled law where it was derived: absolute relief h proportional to g^-1.09 for g >= 1, cited to Guimond+2022 (doi:10.3847/PSJ/ac562e), with the SLOPE from the paper and the AMPLITUDE anchored to Earth's observed 19.9 km. The paper's own amplitude is never used (it under-predicts Solar-System relief ~3x).

verifyVia.input: Evaluate the new envelope across g >= 1 at fixed composition and back out the delivered ABSOLUTE exponent as log(E*R)/log(g).
verifyVia.observable: Delivered absolute exponent is -1.09 across the whole g >= 1 range ON THE ROCKY SUPER-EARTH BRANCH (not -1.09 at one point and something else elsewhere), and the envelope returns exactly 1.0 at the Earth point R=1, g=1. [corrected during build 2026-07-28: SCOPED to the rocky super-Earth branch, and two residuals are DECLARED rather than claimed away. (i) The 10 non-rocky presets receive -0.678235294117647, because body-condition-vector.js:87 gates the self-compression shape on the rocky class and leaves every other class on the linear R/R_c ratio -- a declared, non-goal debt of the predecessor workstream. No continuous two-argument reliefEnvelope(R,g) form can deliver -1.09 there; it needs either a signature change or paying that debt, and neither is in scope. (ii) The rocky sub-branch corner (drawn R < 1 while g >= 1) receives -0.928235294117647, because below 1 R-earth gravity goes as R^(4/3) and the conversion exponent is 0.75 not 0.5882; worst magnitude error ~1.8%, reachable on Magma (R in [0.9214,1)) and Moon/Mercury (R in [0.9952,1)) by slider only, never by a seeded draw. Also: the literal log(E*R)/log(g) recipe in the input above is exact ONLY on the synthetic ROCKY_FP curve (R_c = 1, g_c = 1); anywhere else the delivered exponent must be read as a log-log slope.]

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The seam is continuous. The two branches are in different variables (shipped fit is fractional-in-g with no radius term; derived law is absolute-in-g converted to fractional via 1/R), so they agree at the Earth point but not automatically along the rest of the g = 1 locus. The shipped form must have no jump anywhere reachable. [corrected during build 2026-07-28: the premise that the derived branch must carry a 1/R term is FALSE, and the adopted form has no radius term at all. Along any physical trajectory g = g_c*(R/R_c)^n, the seam radius R_s (where that body's gravity crosses 1) satisfies R_s/R = g^(-1/n) exactly -- R_c and g_c both cancel -- so the seam-normalised /R form collapses identically to the g-only law g^-(1.09 + 1/n). Pinning n = 1.70 (the rocky super-Earth branch) gives Q_RELIEF_DERIVED = 1.678235294117647. Continuity is then structural, not fitted: Math.pow(1, +/-anything) === 1, so both branches meet at exactly 1 for ANY radius. Measured: one-sided ratio at g = 1 +/- 1e-9 is 1.0000000023 at every preset seam radius.]

verifyVia.input: Sweep g across 1.0 from below and above, at every preset's canonical radius AND across each preset's full seeded radius draw band; also sweep R at fixed g across the boundary.
verifyVia.observable: No discontinuity at the seam on any preset or any reachable (R, g) pair: the one-sided limits agree to floating-point tolerance. A jump anywhere in the reachable space is a FAIL, not a rounding note.
